color.note: One light theme for the MVP. Brand: navy ink + teal. Flagged areas on an ad are outline boxes with numbered pins, never filled; yellow only marks words quoted in a finding. Status colors only ever mean status, always with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the ad canvas, the header. antd colorBgContainer.

tokens.name: surface-subtle
tokens.usage: App background behind panels. antd colorBgLayout.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Dividers and card borders. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, select and checkbox borders: 3.1:1 on surface, meets WCAG 1.4.11. antd colorBorder.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the logo: 16:1 on surface, 15:1 on surface-subtle, 14:1 on primary-soft, 12:1 on highlight, 12.6:1 on mint.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text and metadata: 7.6:1 on surface, 7.1:1 on surface-subtle.

tokens.name: ink-placeholder
tokens.usage: Input placeholders: 4.8:1 on surface (antd's default fails).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Primary button, links, selected nav, focus ring: 5.5:1 on surface. One primary button per view.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill: 5.5:1.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected queue row, 'New' tags. Ink (14:1) or primary (4.9:1) text on it.

tokens.name: mint
tokens.usage: Brand tint: the logo lens and small fills, with ink on it (12.6:1). Never text on surface (1.3:1).

tokens.name: highlight
tokens.usage: Words quoted inside a finding's text, like a highlighter pen. Ink on it (12:1). Never on the ad itself, UI chrome or status.

tokens.name: highlight-outline
tokens.usage: 2px outline around a flagged area on an image, with a 1px white keyline and a numbered pin; a 2px underline in text assets. No fill, so it never hides or looks like part of the ad.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Critical findings and Rejected assets: 6.6:1 on surface, 6.0:1 on critical-soft. Always with the x icon and a word.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Critical and Rejected tags. Critical text on it.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Caution findings and Changes required: an orange clearly apart from critical red. 5.2:1 on surface, 4.8:1 on warning-soft. Always with the ! icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Caution and Changes required tags. Warning text on it.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Good checks and Approved assets: 5.6:1 on surface, 5.4:1 on success-soft. Always with the check icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of Good and Approved tags. Success text on it.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Inter from Google Fonts: wide, very legible at 12–14px, the logo's face. antd fontSize stays 14.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The asset name at the top of the review panel.

styles.name: heading
styles.sample: Rate claim is missing the full APR range
styles.usage: A finding's headline, panel section headings.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Reg Z requires the APR range and any conditions behind the lowest rate.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Labels inside a finding, emphasized words.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside tags and between buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list, between a finding's parts.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections of a panel.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, highlight boxes on ads.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the ad frame.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Number badges, avatars.

shadow.note: Borders do most of the work; shadows only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: The selected queue row and the ad frame.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers, drawers, dropdowns.
